ParticipatedDuration.Extended now encodes the approved family with independent-branch and omission controls. NeverCeasing adds forward persistence to FutureUnending so a gap after presence is not described as never ceasing; no beginninglessness or total order is required. Finite long duration and finite short participated operation witness that the other branches do not require never-ceasing duration. Primitive stability and reception in the same aspect are required only for participation, not for either other branch; neither is identified with aevum or proper eternity. Only ETERNITY_AND_STABLE_DURATION_2 has its allowance removed. Original sense 3 and 4 bindings remain absent by owner direction. Richer measure investigation: Physics IV.11 TimeIsNumberOfMotionAccordingToBeforeAfterReading distinguishes time from motion but leaves number-of-motion as a Prop parameter; TimeMeasuresMoreAndLessMotionAsNumberReading encodes an inference between Prop parameters, not a comparison/measurement map. Physics IV.12 TimeMeasuresMotionReading and reciprocal measurement likewise do not define an admissible unit, counted extent, composition of intervals, or calibration connecting motion to temporal quantity. Those are candidate specification questions, not newly necessary axioms. For aevum a specification must say what substantial being is measured and how its internally all-at-once measure coexists with adjunct actual OR potential change and external annihilation; constant selected states do not settle those distinctions. No measure surrogate, new source claim, new argument or root closure is introduced.
